mapper.select: SELECT state.version, state.content_hash FROM diagram_canvas_state state JOIN diagram ON diagram.id = state.diagram_id AND diagram.user_id = state.user_id WHERE state.diagram_id = #{plan.diagramId} AND state.user_id = #{plan.owner.ownerKey} AND diagram.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagram_conversation_message (diagram_id, user_id, session_id, client_message_id, role, content) VALUES (#{plan.diagramId}, #{plan.owner.ownerKey}, #{plan.sessionId}, #{plan.messageId}, 'agent', #{plan.content})

INSERT INTO source_citation (id, owner_key, target_type, diagram_id, canvas_version, message_id, claim_key, support_type, state) VALUES (#{citation.citationId}, #{plan.owner.ownerKey}, 'ANSWER_CLAIM', #{plan.diagramId}, #{canvasVersion}, #{plan.messageId}, #{citation.claimKey}, #{citation.supportType}, CASE WHEN #{citation.supportType} = 'AI_KNOWLEDGE' THEN NULL ELSE 'VERIFIED' END)

INSERT INTO citation_evidence (citation_id, evidence_id, version_id, revision_id, citation_key, use_role, source_origin) VALUES (#{citationId}, #{link.evidenceId}, #{link.versionId}, #{link.revisionId}, #{link.citationKey}, #{link.useRole}, #{link.origin})

INSERT INTO diagram_source_pin (diagram_id, material_id, version_id, processing_revision_id, state, first_used_at, latest_citation_at) VALUES (#{plan.diagramId}, #{link.materialId}, #{link.versionId}, #{link.revisionId}, 'ACTIVE', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = 'ACTIVE', latest_citation_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
